summary: This short note is a biographical entry on Mirza Mehdy Ispahani (also known as Sadri Ispahani), who lived from 1923 to 2004 and was the son of Mirza Ahmad Ispahani. He served as Chairman of the company M.M. Ispahani from 1949 until 2004. The note also records that his son, Mirza Ali Behrouze Ispahani, was elected Chairman of M.M. Ispahani in 2004.
one_line: Biographical note on Mirza Mehdy Ispahani, long-serving chairman of M.M. Ispahani (1949–2004), and his successor son Mirza Ali Behrouze Ispahani.
key_facts: Mirza Mehdy Ispahani, also known as Sadri Ispahani, lived from 1923 to 2004.
Mirza Mehdy Ispahani was the son of Mirza Ahmad Ispahani.
Mirza Mehdy Ispahani was Chairman of M.M. Ispahani from 1949 till 2004.
Mirza Ali Behrouze Ispahani was the son of Mirza Mehdy Ispahani.
Mirza Ali Behrouze Ispahani was elected as the Chairman of M.M. Ispahani in 2004.
